title: Tallest Billboard
goal: Build two disjoint rod supports of equal height with the greatest possible height.
strategy: Map height difference to the best shorter-support height. Each rod can be skipped, added to the taller side, or added to the shorter side; only the best shorter height for a given difference matters.

edgeCases: Equal rods make two matching supports directly
No nonempty equal supports leaves height zero
The tallest equal result may skip a long outlier
